executionMode: Six sequential one-case campaigns, each with a fresh authenticated HTTP/WebSocket session. Do not execute the catalog as one shared-session campaign.
limitsScope: One cumulative cap across all six isolated campaigns, including authentication/server overhead, spacing, failed attempts and any retries. No per-case cap reset.
selectionDisclosure: BD10 requested explicitly to exercise real notification and reused across permission/priority conditions. Author inspected public baseline outcome labels: BD10 contradicted, BD09 and BD07 supported; these known development outcomes informed branch selection. This is a diagnostic action cohort, not independent accuracy validation.
completionRules: Run only after root records final clean source commit/hash and full check.
Each case gets a new session/server through a separate runLiveCampaign invocation; capture HTTP401 probes and correlated terminal receipt.

Before each invocation subtract all prior dispatched attempts, request bytes, measured plus unknown reserved tokens, and elapsed wall time from the cohort budget; never clamp exhausted capacity upward.
Abort the cohort on any local/transport stop, unknown completed Jev usage, actual overrun, or exhaustion. Preserve all received reports; do not rerun or replace a case to obtain notify.
Enforce at least4100ms between automatic HTTP dispatches across isolated invocations. Count this waiting in cohort wall time, record it separately from processing latency.

AD02 passes only with a real claim.result whose verdict is contradicted and presentation is notify/selected_topic_contradiction. An abstention or operational failure prevents this branch from being exercised.
Verdict-dependent silence scenarios require the declared verdict and exact reason code; an abstention that happens to be silent is inconclusive for that target branch.
AD04 additionally requires numeric practical-consequence below0.8 with no selected topic. Unknown or high priority is separately reported, not called a low-priority pass.
AD05 requires private_or_personal skip, silent presentation and zero Exa attempts. AD06 requires a permitted manual check with muted silence, not a rejected request.
All retained selected references require fresh external exact-scope review before claiming source-verified factual correctness; copied ground-truth records do not supply that review.

No factual outputs from this cohort enlarge the broader-development or release factual denominator. Report latency, cold status, attempts, bytes, tokens, costs, privacy and all six action outcomes separately.
